m1.typescript: m1 a production deploy takes three round trips and keeps no state

e1.typescript: e1 a staging deploy and a status call finish at once and the tool list is cacheable

e2.typescript: e2 the server only asks what the client declared it can answer

e3.typescript: e3 a no or a missing answer is handled without an error

e4.typescript: e4 a state the server did not sign is refused

e5.typescript: e5 a state works only for the same user the same call and before it expires

e6.typescript: e6 a request the server cannot serve is a protocol error with a code

e7.typescript: e7 the state carries the whole context and an answer alone never skips a step

wrong-no-expiry.defect: accepts a requestState after its expiry time

wrong-any-principal.defect: accepts a requestState that was issued to another user

wrong-no-digest.defect: accepts a requestState on a call whose arguments differ from the ones it was issued for

wrong-bad-state-restarts.defect: silently starts the flow over when the requestState is not one it signed

wrong-elicit-without-capability.defect: sends an elicitation request to a client that did not declare the capability

wrong-decline-continues.defect: carries on with the deployment after the user declined

wrong-error-on-missing-input.defect: answers a retry that lacks the requested input with a protocol error instead of asking again

wrong-list-uncacheable.defect: lists the tools with a cache lifetime of zero

wrong-version-ignored.defect: serves a request whose protocol version is not the one it supports

wrong-answer-alone-skips.defect: takes an answer that arrives with no requestState as if the question had been asked
